source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: Koffan is a shopping list app in Go: main.go wires the routes, which serve the HTML templates, the REST API and the synchronization WebSocket. All requests go through db/queries.go to SQLite, and outgoing webhooks notify automation tools.
